outputs: player-facing scene only through current operational gate
must: load source and hidden prep before scene
respect player action and real dice

must_not_receive: NPC-only information absent a played reveal

must: acquire only through observation, statement, or accessible evidence
retain uncertainty when source is insufficient

global_rules: GM_HIDDEN labels control disclosure, not authorized agent access.
No prompt or report may contain secret plot content unless the role is agent/Narrator and the artifact is explicitly hidden.
New prospective NPCs and events are not canon until played and persisted.
No automatic scene readiness, permission, XP, or state transition.
emergency_flow: If canon conflict, retcon need, unavailable source, impossible mechanics, or true access failure arises, pause only the affected branch; finish independent work; record a spoiler-safe administrative blocker.

validation_behavior.unknown: Preserve historical unknowns unless the explicit open variant covers them.
validation_behavior.failure: Do not turn an unsuccessful test into hidden success; provide alternate or incomplete closure.
validation_behavior.refusal: Respect refusal; any later NPC action needs its own cause.
validation_behavior.early_discovery: Reveal only what source actually supports, with no extra detail.
validation_behavior.abandonment: No automatic retaliation or infinite hook.
validation_behavior.contract_reference_validation: Resolve Markdown anchors and JSON pointers before D11 passes; evaluate each pass criterion and its declared reducer assertions.

AGENT_KNOWLEDGE.disclosure_rule: Use only for the declared audience; NPC action requires their own acquired knowledge.
